title: On bungee message receive

description: When a bungee player joins the network

description: When a bungee player leaves the network

description: When the client connects to a server

description: Checks if the server and the bungeecord are linked

client is connected
client is(n't| not) connected

description: The hover list displayed when hovering the player's size in the ping's list.

description: The maximum size of the connected players in a proxy ping event

description: Returns the IP address of the player pinging the proxy

bungee ip of pinger
pinger's bungee ip [address]

description: The protocol message displayed if the protocol version number doesn't match the client's one.

description: The protocol version number in a proxy ping event. For further informations, see https://wiki.vg/Protocol_version_numbers
